Do You Need a Garbage Disposal Repair Service?

Nowadays, garbage disposals are indispensable for the modern homeowner, and that’s exactly why any problems with them can be so disruptive. Unfortunately, they’re more or less inevitable at some point or another. Your garbage is going to accumulate wear and tear with regular use, become less efficient, and eventually break down. Fortunately, most such issues are relatively minor and simple to fix. Clogs, jamming, and leaks are among the most common problems and they can usually be repaired in less than an hour. However, in some rare cases, the malfunctions you’re dealing with may turn out to be more serious.

For example, the motor may burn out because of overheating or prolonged use and your garbage disposal may become impossible to turn on. As replacing a burnt-out motor can be prohibitively expensive in most cases, your plumber may advise you to invest in a brand-new device instead. Although a replacement service comes with a slightly higher upfront cost, it’s likely to end up being cheaper in the long run as you’ll be highly unlikely to encounter further issues anytime soon.

You can do your part by maintaining your garbage disposal. For example, you can run some chopped-up lemons or limes through it if it starts to smell. However, stubborn odors that won’t go away are a sign of a clog or another issue, so give us a call to take a look. You should also never put fibrous items like celery or non-organic items like plastic bags through your disposal. It isn’t meant for these and they can get caught up in the system and cause jamming.
